text:
sarah: Quick heads-up — PR is ready but putting a hold on merge until we have a design/spec sign-off. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8124. Need the spec link + any SLO/rollback notes. cc @diego @zane

diego: Can you paste a short design TL;DR here? don’t have time for a long read right now. what's the change and the main risk? :eyes:

sarah: TL;DR: route cold-start traffic to a small fallback pool when route latency > threshold. Adds config flag route.fallback_latency_ms and a migration step for routing tables. Expected perf: ~5% better p95 on bursty traffic. Main risk is config drift during rollout if the migration script isn't atomic. Draft spec (WIP): https://docs.internal/specs/serve-fallbacks-draft

emily: SLO note: have you measured token latency impact on the happy path? if p95 goes >10% we need canary gating. also call out cache TTL changes — that could affect downstream throughput.

zane: If we gate on a canary, what split/duration do you expect? I can reserve a 1hr canary window tomorrow afternoon if you want.

neha: Quick arch ask: we need an RFC link (not just a draft) or a designated owner who will shepherd the doc to approved state before merge. also include a 1-paragraph rollback plan and changelog blurb.

sarah: Got it. I'll publish a short RFC summary by EOD and attach changelog. Marking PR DNM for now. @prodops-bot please apply a release-block for PR 8124 (awaiting design doc).

prodops-bot: Release hold set — PR 8124 flagged DNM. Block reason: awaiting design/spec sign-off.

diego: After you post the RFC link, can someone from arch (cc @neha) drop a one-line approval (:eyes: + ok to merge) here? that's sufficient to lift the block.

sarah: RFC now published for review: https://docs.internal/rfcs/2026/serve-fallbacks (status: reviewing). Short 3-bullet summary posted in the doc: 1) routing fallback rule, 2) config + migration script, 3) rollback/metrics to watch.

zane: skimmed the RFC — migration script needs a compatibility shim if older nodes keep sending v1 headers. please add a migration lock or graceful fallback handling.

neha: I can give formal ack once the migration lock is in place and the canary metrics (p50/p95/error-rate) are defined in the RFC. ping me when updated and I'll add :thumbsup:.

sarah: Thanks — I'll update the RFC with migration lock and the metric table, then ping this thread.

sarah: (follow-up) updated RFC with migration lock and a 1hr canary plan; added changelog snippet. pinging @neha and @zane again for final checks.
